jobs.description:
This organization is a leading player in the manufacturing industry, helping production companies efficiently process, move and manage raw materials and bulk goods. With deep technical expertise, it develops and delivers innovative solutions that make manufacturing processes smarter, safer, and more reliable. From concept and design to implementation, customization is at the heart of every project, ensuring each solution is tailored to the customer's specific needs. Through a strong focus on quality and innovation, the company enables its customers to improve performance and achieve sustainable growth. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, collaborate, and continuously develop their expertise. The company culture is defined by entrepreneurship, craftsmanship and a shared passion for technology. With a forward-looking mindset, the organization continuously invests in new technologies and sustainable processes. In doing so, it contributes every day to a stronger, more efficient and more innovative industrial sector.#MANUFACTURING #PRODUCTION #ENGINEERING #TECHNICAL #TECHNICALSALES #SALESENGINEER #SALES #BUSINESSDEVELOPMENT #BUSINESSMANAGER #STRATEGIC #SCANINAVIA #BELGIUM #ANTWERPEN #OOST-VLAANDEREN

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and implement a strategic growth plan for the Scandinavian market.
• Analyze market opportunities, build a strong network, and identify new business opportunities.
• Coordinate and support local agents to drive market growth and commercial success.
• Establish clear structures, processes, and action plans to ensure efficient market development.
• Coach and train agents to effectively communicate the technical value and benefits of our solutions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers, partners, and key stakeholders.
• Work closely with agents to create strong first introductions with potential customers and build trust through both commercial and technical expertise.
• Translate customer needs into commercial opportunities and transfer them to sales and engineering teams for further development.
• Remain involved throughout the entire customer journey and foster long-term business growth.
• Professionalize existing partnerships and continuously optimize commercial processes.
• Support and initiate sales and marketing activities to further strengthen market presence.
• During the initial phase, travel regularly throughout Scandinavia to gain a deep understanding of customers, agents, and market dynamics. Over time, the role will evolve toward strategic coordination and follow-up from Belgium.
• Contribute to the potential establishment of future offices in Scandinavia and, at a later stage, take ownership of strategic European Key Accounts.

• Proven experience in business development, account management, market development, or commercial project coordination within a technical or industrial environment.
• A technical degree or equivalent experience within the manufacturing industry, process industry, or industrial technology sector.
• Able to combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and turn opportunities into tangible results.
• Strong relationship builder with the ability to connect stakeholders and coordinate complex collaborations.
• Highly organized, takes ownership, and follows up projects in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
• Excellent commercial, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate others.
• Comfortable working in an international environment, fluent in English, willing to travel and knowledge of Dutch, French, German, and/or a Scandinavian language is considered a strong asset.

Our client is a growing international company active in the FMCG sector, known for developing and distributing innovative consumer products across European markets. With a strong focus on quality, sustainability, and collaboration, they have built a dynamic workplace where employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute to the company's continued success. Their modern offices in Brussels serve as a key hub for their Benelux operations.

Jobomschrijving

As Office Manager, you will act as the central point of contact for all office-related matters and play a crucial role in maintaining an efficient and welcoming work environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the daily operations and overall organization of the office.
• Coordinating suppliers, facility management partners, and external service providers.
• Ensuring office spaces are functional, well-maintained, and fully equipped.
• Organizing internal meetings, events, and company activities.
• Managing office budgets, invoices, and administrative processes.
• Supporting HR-related administration, including onboarding and employee documentation.
• Coordinating travel arrangements, accommodation bookings, and meeting logistics.
• Providing administrative support to the local leadership team.
• Acting as the first point of contact for visitors and external stakeholders.
• Identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes and office efficiency.

• You have previous experience in an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar position.
• You can demonstrate a successful track record in a professional office environment.
• You have an excellent command of English combined with either French or Dutch.
• Knowledge of the third language (French or Dutch) is considered a strong asset.
• You are highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• You possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• You are hands-on, solution-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
• You have strong attention to detail and a professional approach.
• You are proficient with Microsoft Office and common administrative tools.

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Company located in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
	
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines	
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products	
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner	
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests	
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment

	
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required	
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• A forklift certificate is a plus	
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)	
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

Company located in the Roeselare region.

Jobomschrijving

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
	
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse	
• Loading and unloading trucks	
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system	
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)	
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• You work accurately and value order and structure	
• Safety is always your top priority	
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Medior Accountant to join its Accounting team and play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability and continuity of our accounting operations.

Our client is a leading Belgian communications and marketing company, with offices in the heart of Brussels and close to the trainstation.

Description

• Ensure correct VAT treatment and support monitoring

• Autonomous, structured, detail‑oriented and proactive
• Strong team player with good communication and prioritization skills

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.

• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.

Are you an experienced CNC operator looking for a new challenge? We urgently need skilled professionals to join our team at our brand-new machine shop! 
Our workshop has moved to a location 10 times larger with many more machines, and we’re looking for enthusiastic people to help us grow!

• Experience in CNC programming, turning, and milling (if you only have turning experience, we have options, but milling experience alone is not sufficient).
• Experience with 5-axis machines and knowledge of more than 3-axis operations.

Our client is looking for a Customer Care Project & SRS Coordinator who will play a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of customer projects from quotation through delivery. Acting as the link between multiple internal stakeholders, this person will help drive operational excellence while ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a globally recognised industrial manufacturer with a long-standing history of innovation and excellence. Serving customers across a wide range of sectors worldwide, the company is known for its high-quality engineered solutions, strong customer focus and commitment to continuous improvement.
The organisation combines the stability of an international group with a collaborative and people-oriented culture. Employees are encouraged to grow professionally while working in a dynamic and multicultural environment.

 

Omschrijving

• Coordinate projects in collaboration with Customer Care, Project Coordination and Engineering teams.
• Act as a key point of contact between internal departments to ensure seamless project execution.
• Manage quotation and order-related activities throughout the project lifecycle.
• Monitor material availability and proactively expedite orders when required.
• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain teams to guarantee timely delivery of products.
• Ensure excellent customer service by adhering to established processes and best practices.
• Support customers by analysing requests, questions and operational challenges.
• Assist in customer care improvement initiatives and training-related projects.
• Contribute to operational projects and provide support to management when needed.
 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in customer service, project coordination or operations.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
• Experience working with ERP systems is considered an advantage.
• Customer-focused with excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working cross-functionally in an international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a strong asset.
• Flexible mindset and willingness to occasionally travel.

This Receptionist role is a front-of-house position focused on delivering a professional experience to visitors while ensuring the smooth day-to-day coordination of office operations, meeting facilities and administrative support. The successful candidate will manage reception activities, room bookings, travel arrangements, courier services and general office support within an international business environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a prestigious international law firm based in Brussels. To support its operations during a temporary period, they are currently looking for a Receptionist to join their team until the end of December.

 

Description

As a Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for visitors and play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the switchboard, forwarding calls, screening incoming calls and taking messages.
• Welcoming visitors and ensuring a professional reception experience.
• Supporting visitors with administrative requests such as printing, copying and other practical needs.
• Managing visitor badges and access procedures.
• Coordinating meeting room bookings and updating reservations as required.
• Ordering catering services and assisting with meeting room set-up when needed.
• Monitoring conference rooms and liaising with internal teams to ensure facilities are maintained.
• Arranging travel, hotel, restaurant and transportation bookings.
• Organising courier services and outgoing mail.
• Coordinating flower orders and other office-related requests.
• Acting as a point of contact with IT and other support functions when required.

 

• Previous experience in a Receptionist, Front Office or Administrative Support role.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Professional, positive and service-oriented attitude.
• Fluent English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• Good command of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
• Proactive, flexible and reliable approach to work.
• Team player with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage shared mailboxes and handle day-to-day business correspondence.
• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.
• Support payment processing, budget tracking and expense administration.
• Coordinate with external finance partners and maintain relevant documentation.
• Oversee recurring fees, contributions and other incoming payments.
• Track contracts, renewals, deadlines and purchasing activities.
• Prepare administrative and financial reports, dashboards and internal tracking files.
• Ensure project documentation, agreements and supporting records are complete and up to date.
• Assist with the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate office facilities, suppliers, equipment and service providers.
• Support employee onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Maintain efficient filing systems and contribute to process improvements.
• Provide broader administrative and operational support as needed.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Previous experience in administration, operations support, office coordination or a similar role.
• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
